review_evidence: The unit contains 185 Lean modules under lean/, spanning the project axioms, combinatorics, algebra, topology/geometry, physics-model definitions, and theorem developments.

Direct inspection of lean/QLF_Axioms.lean found inductive types, recursive definitions, lemmas, and proved invariants such as double_fold_identity, full_prune_invariant, and zfa_implies_critical_line.
Direct inspection of lakefile.lean found a Mathlib dependency and a lean_lib root list enumerating the retained modules, with no additional formal theorem content.

rules.content_invariant: The exact lakefile is only package/dependency/library-root configuration. Every named QLF formal module it lists remains physically retained under lean/, including all definitions, axioms, lemmas, and proofs.

review_evidence: lakefile.lean read in full: `import Lake`, `open Lake DSL`, `package «QuantumLogicalFramework»`, comments on pinning Mathlib, `require mathlib from git ... @ "abec794dccc82583e8ac6f31968adf01c264d2da"`, `@[default_target] lean_lib QLF where srcDir := "lean"`, and a `roots := #[...]` list of module names from `QLF_Axioms` to `QLF_GoldenSilver`. Declaration grep over the 57 lean/QLF_*.lean files: minimum count 3 (QLF_AxiomAudit.lean), then 5 (QLF_EinsteinEquations.lean, QLF_Turbulence.lean), 6 (QLF_PhaseAssignment.lean), 7 (QLF_HolographicDensity.lean, QLF_Universality.lean); no file has zero.

QLF_AxiomAudit.lean contains `#print axioms` checks of named theorems (for example QLF.PhaseRule.phase_rule, QLF.Fredkin.fredkin_bijective) in addition to its own declarations; it is retained as formal content.

summary: Surveyed all 58 listed files. Read lakefile.lean completely (251 lines, 6387 bytes): it is still pure Lake build configuration, and its larger size is only a longer roots list. Grepped the 57 lean/QLF_*.lean files for line-initial Lean declarations (theorem, lemma, def, structure, class, instance, inductive, abbrev, example, axiom). Every one has at least 3 such declarations; the lowest counts were QLF_AxiomAudit (3), QLF_EinsteinEquations (5), QLF_Turbulence (5). All 57 Lean modules stay searchable as formal content. Only lakefile.lean is excluded, as in the earlier review of this unit.
